children: Aave governance has passed AIP-514, enabling Pendle's PT-USDG to be listed as collateral on Aave V3 on X Layer with up to 93.59% LTV under the approved parameters.

The approval allows users to borrow against fixed-yield PT-USDG positions within the specified LTV limit, adding a route for liquidity and leverage around the asset. That collateral use can strengthen the utility case for Pendle PT assets and support demand for PT-USDG, subject to borrowing activity and risk controls on the market.
The direct effect on AAVE is described as modest, since the change concerns a collateral listing for PT-USDG on one Aave V3 deployment rather than a change to AAVE's token economics.
当 PT-USDG 可以作为 Aave 抵押品后，用户可以在保留固定收益仓位的同时，进一步获得流动性和资本效率。

title: Aave: Enables PT-USDG collateral listing - 31 Aug 2026
